acs.text: Negative: a content file or fixture holding a term from the client-name denylist fails the CI denylist check without printing the term, and the check fails closed when the denylist secret is missing (ADR-0013).
acs.raw_artifact:
--- CI wiring: secret fed to the check
54:        run: mise run repo:denylist
56:          DENYLIST: ${{ secrets.DENYLIST }}
--- fixture repo: content file holding a placeholder term
--- negative: denied term present
EXIT=1
denylist-check: denied term in content.yaml
denylist-check: failed; terms are never printed
TERM PRINTED: no
--- fail closed: DENYLIST unset, no .denylist.local
EXIT=2
denylist-check: no denylist found (set DENYLIST or create .denylist.local); failing closed
--- fail closed: DENYLIST empty
EXIT=2
denylist-check: no denylist found (set DENYLIST or create .denylist.local); failing closed
--- positive control: clean file only
EXIT=0
denylist-check: clean (1 files)
--- mise run repo:test (behaviour tests)
EXIT=0
[repo:test] $ bash scripts/denylist-check.test.sh
ok   a denied term fails the check
ok   the term is never printed
ok   the offending file is named
ok   matching ignores case
ok   a denied term in a file name fails
ok   a file name holding a term is not echoed
ok   a clean tree passes
ok   a missing denylist fails closed
ok   an empty denylist fails closed
ok   a blank-only denylist fails closed
ok   the local file feeds the check
ok   the hook may skip when no list exists
ok   only the named files are scanned
ok   a named file holding a term fails
ok   a non-ASCII file name is still scanned
ok   a denied term in a non-ASCII file name fails
ok   a non-ASCII file name holding a term is not echoed
ok   a denied term in a commit message fails
ok   a message's term is never printed
ok   the offending commit is named
ok   commits outside the range are not read
ok   messages are read only when a range is given
ok   an unreadable range fails closed
ok   a denied term in the title fails
ok   the title's term is never printed
ok   a clean title passes
all passed
acs.verdict_reason: Fixture with placeholder term exits 1 naming only the file, term not printed; unset and empty DENYLIST exit 2 failing closed; repo:test all passed.
acs.no_visual_reason: CLI exit codes and output; no rendered state
